profile.headline: Senior Front End Developer at UBS
profile.summary:
•	Experienced front-end developer with hands-on experience on the web with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.   
  • 10 years of specialized experience in the web and mobile web domains, working under various business verticals including retail, banking and manufacturing
•	Expertise in Object Oriented Programming using JavaScript.
•	Strong analytical skills with ability to quickly understand client’s business needs.
•	Strong experiences to define, design, develop and deploy user experience best practices and solutions in end-to-end systems development life cycle.
•	Experience in applying user experience style guide requirements around complex web applications and build workflow based user interfaces.
•	Niche skills include web application development using  React ,Redux and using responsive web design
•	Experienced in all stages of Software development life cycle (SDLC) starting from gathering business specifications, analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of projects using agile development methodology.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Senior front end developer at Investment Bank research division of UBS.
Working close with research analysts to create high performance applications using cutting edge technologies like react js ,core JavaScript ,d3 etc. 
Responsible for design and development of various critical applications used by analysts in research team.

positions.title: Senior Front End Developer (TCS)
positions.description:
Senior web developer for walmart for multiple web applications.

Responsibilities:
-	Collected business requirements, provide analysis and design of web applications for desktop and mobiles. 
-	Developed high performance Single Page Web Applications (SPA) and hybrid mobile applications.

Technology Used  : Javascript, HTML5 ,CSS3, Angular js ,Ionic Framework ,SASS,Gulp, Webpack, ES6

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
As a lead front-end developer at the Mobility and Pervasive Computing Unit, I am responsible for leading the design and development of multiple web and mobile applications.

Responsibilities:
Develop high performance Single Page Web Applications (SPA) and hybrid mobile applications.

Technology Used : Vanilla Javascript,Backbone JS,Angular JS,HTML5,CSS3,Bootstrap, Gulp,Sass, Apache Cordova

projects.title: Market Thinking
projects.description:
Market thinking application for collecting customer thoughts on current market.
Implemented using React js and Redux which is responsive across all devices and desktops.

projects.title: HTML Renditions
projects.description:
HTML renditions provide research data for different clients of UBS.
My responsibilities included analyzing the requirements and  making sure the most optimized UI code is delivered which provides very good user experience.
